title: A caller with write permission in a namespace can terminate temporal-proxy through memory exhaustion by storing highly…
description: Temporal-proxy version 1.2.0 contains a vulnerability where a caller with write permission in a namespace can cause the proxy to terminate due to memory exhaustion. This occurs by storing highly compressed payloads in Workflow history that decompress to large sizes, causing the proxy to consume excessive memory when reading the history. The issue affects the /decode endpoint of the codec server when enabled. The vulnerability is fixed in version 1.2.1.
